v21-25.candidate: We will replace for you a force like the force you lost, cavalry for cavalry and chariots for chariots. We will fight them on level ground and be stronger than they.” He listened to them and did so.

v21-42.candidate: He said to him, “Thus says the Lord: ‘Because you let a doomed man out of your hand, your life will be for his life, and your people for his people.’”
